jobs.title: General Manager, B2B Marketplace (VP-Level)
jobs.description:
Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year.



We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care.

 

The General Manager of the Clinic Purchasing Platform is responsible for the performance and operations of Vetcove's flagship purchasing platform and many of the company's most important enterprise customer relationships.

 

You will lead the teams responsible for Account Management and Customer Experience, overseeing a combined organization of approximately 15 customer-facing professionals through two experienced managers. Together, these teams support Vetcove's largest corporate customers, driving adoption, retention, operational excellence, and long-term partner success.

 

You will be accountable for the success of Vetcove's largest enterprise partners. That means understanding their business, identifying opportunities to deepen each relationship, coordinating execution across Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Operations, and ensuring Vetcove consistently delivers on its commitments.

 

This is a highly cross-functional leadership role that combines operational execution, people leadership, and commercial strategy. You'll be responsible for developing your managers, scaling the organization as the business grows, and ensuring Vetcove continues to deliver an exceptional experience on this platform.

 

What you'll do

 - Own the performance and operations of Vetcove's Clinic Purchasing Platform

 - Lead and develop two experienced managers responsible for Account Management and Customer Experience, overseeing a combined organization of approximately 15 customer-facing professionals.

 - Partner with Product, Engineering, Sales, Marketing, and Operations to prioritize customer needs and drive cross-functional initiatives.

 - Gather customer and market feedback to help inform commercial strategy, product direction, and long-term investment decisions.

 - Review and provide guidance on executive-facing customer materials, including proposals, business reviews, strategic plans, and performance updates.

 - Continuously improve the processes, metrics, and operating rhythms used by the Account Management and Customer Experience organizations.

 - Conduct regular business reviews with your managers to evaluate account health, identify opportunities and risks, and ensure teams are executing against priorities.

 - Travel up to 25% to meet with enterprise customers for strategic planning sessions, business reviews, and executive relationship building.

 

You should have

 - Bachelors Degree

 - 8+ years of account management, relationship-based sales, or similar experience

 - Previous people management responsibilities, including experience managing managers or leading teams through other leaders

 - Proven experience managing complex enterprise relationships

 - An eagerness to be involved in the details of ongoing projects, despite a high-level role & title

 - Strong attention to detail and project management skills

 - Interest in data and more quantitative problem solving

 - Ability to adapt quickly and manage many concurrent responsibilities

 - Expertise in Excel, PowerPoint, and Word

 - A positive attitude and team-based mentality; excellent collaboration skills

 - Comfortability in a fast-paced environment

 

Benefits (Full Time Roles)

 - 100% remote within the USA

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

 - Automatic 401k contribution

 - Employee referral program

 - At home office set up

 - Bi-annual company retreats

 - Open vacation policy

 - Equity

 - Monthly team events


The typical base pay range for this role across the U.S. is: $170,000/year - $280,000/year + bonus + equity + benefits. There is a different range applicable to specific work locations. For Colorado, the salary range is: $180,000 - $230,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. This salary range is a good faith estimate of what Vetcove may pay for this position at the time of posting. Actual compensation may vary based on skills, qualifications, and experience. The range reflects the base hourly rate or annual compensation (as applicable), and does not include bonus, equity or other incentives.


In addition to base compensation, Vetcove offers a comprehensive benefits
package. Please refer to the “Benefits (Full Time Roles)” section above for more
details.

 

To apply, please submit your application through Vetcove’s Careers Page. The application deadline is December 1, 2026.

 

Please note we are unable to sponsor work visas at this time.

Vetcove is seeking a highly motivated and analytical Head of Finance (VP-Level) to lead our financial planning, strategy, and operations as we scale. Reporting directly to the Chief Executive Officer, this individual will oversee all aspects of accounting, FP&A, budgeting, and financial reporting while serving as a key business partner to senior leadership across departments.



The ideal candidate will bring both strategic and hands-on experience—someone who can build financial models, guide data-driven decision-making, and implement systems and controls to support rapid growth. You’ll play a critical role in ensuring financial transparency, driving operational efficiency, and positioning Vetcove for long-term success.




WHAT YOU’LL DO

 - Own financial strategy and planning — lead the company’s forecasting, budgeting, and long-range planning processes to ensure alignment with company goals and growth targets

 - Build an FP&A function — develop scalable models, dashboards, and reporting to guide business decisions across revenue, margin, and expense performance

 - Provide strategic business partnership — collaborate closely with department heads (e.g., Sales, Product, Operations, Customer Success) to translate financial insights into actionable strategies

 - Oversee accounting operations — manage general ledger, payroll, tax, invoicing, and reconciliations while ensuring compliance with GAAP and internal controls

 - Develop and refine financial systems — identify and implement tools and processes to improve accuracy, efficiency, and visibility (e.g., ERP, expense management, analytics tools)

 - Deliver timely and accurate reporting — prepare and present monthly, quarterly, and annual financial statements, analyses, and board materials

 - Own cash flow management — forecast, track, and optimize cash receipts and disbursements to support business growth and operational needs

 - Lead audits and tax filings — ensure compliance with all applicable accounting and tax regulations; serve as primary liaison with external auditors and advisors

 - Drive data-informed decision-making — analyze key metrics, unit economics, and business performance to inform pricing, investments, and resource allocation

 - Build and mentor the finance team — hire, develop, and lead a high-performing team capable of supporting a scaling, data-driven organization

 - Bachelors Degree

 - 8+ years of experience in strategic finance ideally within a growth-stage or late-stage startup (eCommerce, SaaS, or marketplace experience preferred)

 - Strong background in FP&A, strategic finance, and operational modeling

 - Proficient knowledge of US GAAP and experience familiarity with executing  audits and compliance

 - Proven ability to design and implement financial planning processes and internal controls

 - Experience partnering cross-functionally with business leaders to drive performance

 - Advanced proficiency with QuickBooks (QBO preferred), googlesheets / excel, finance software stack; Deep experience and desire to implement AI native solutions to drive efficiency, speed & accuracyExcellent analytical and executive levelwritten, and communication skills

jobs.description:

Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care.



About the Position

 

As a Clinic Sales Manager for Home Delivery, you'll own the process of turning interested independent veterinary clinics into active, growing users of Vetcove's home delivery pharmacy platform, and you'll know how to move a pipeline with urgency and conviction.

 

You'll think in systems, not just conversations – building campaigns, assets, and follow-up sequences that drive consistent clinic acquisition at scale, while also showing up sharp in every individual demo and closing call.

 

What You Will Do

 

 - Run product demos and sales meetings for independent clinics that have been registered by our SDR team, converting qualified leads into active HD users

 - Serve as a credible platform expert in every demo and sales conversation, able to address technical questions and articulate value against alternatives

 - Manage a pipeline of warm leads through qualification, demo, follow-up, and close, maintaining clear stage hygiene and next-step ownership throughout

 - Execute a clean handoff to the onboarding team at close, ensuring new clinics have the context and support they need to get up and running quickly

 - Partner closely with the SDR team to give feedback on lead quality, refine targeting criteria, and improve handoff protocols

 - Design and run multi-channel acquisition campaigns – including email sequences, targeted promotions, and seasonal pushes – to drive demo registrations and clinic sign-ups

 - Build and maintain a library of sales assets: slide decks, one-pagers, objection-handling guides, and ROI calculators tailored to independent clinic decision-makers

 - Represent Vetcove at veterinary industry events and trade shows to build relationships, generate leads, and advance pipeline

 - Maintain accurate, up-to-date records in our CRM across all active opportunities

 - Track and report on key sales metrics: demo-to-close rate, average sales cycle, pipeline velocity, and campaign-driven conversion

 - Prepare regular pipeline reviews with data-driven insights for internal stakeholders, flagging blockers and emerging patterns

 

You Should Have 

 - Bachelors Degree

 - 3–5 years of experience in a closing sales role, ideally in SaaS or a technology company selling to SMBs or independent operators

 - A track record of owning a full sales cycle from demo through close with measurable conversion outcomes

 - Strong demo and presentation skills: you can read a room, handle objections live, and leave a prospect with a clear reason to say yes

 - Comfortable selling in a competitive environment: you know how to position against alternatives and win on value, not just price

 - Experience building or contributing to sales campaigns, email sequences, or outbound programs, not just executing plays someone else designed

 - Comfortable in CRM tools: you keep your pipeline clean and your notes current

 - A natural communicator who can adapt from a persuasive group demo to a thoughtful 1:1 follow-up email without losing their voice

 - Highly organized with the discipline to manage a high-volume pipeline without letting anything fall through the cracks

 - Comfortable shifting between campaign-level thinking and individual clinic conversations when the situation calls for it

 - Experience in the veterinary space a strong plus but not required

 

Nice to Haves

 - Familiarity with HubSpot, Salesforce, Attio, or similar CRM tools

 - Experience with email automation tools and sales engagement platforms

 - Prior experience in a high-growth startup environment


Benefits (Full Time Roles)

 - 100% remote within the USA

 - Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance

 - Automatic 401k contribution

 - Employee referral program

 - Bi-annual company retreats

For Colorado, the salary range is: $70,000 - $100,000 + bonus + equity + benefits. This salary range is a good faith estimate of what Vetcove may pay for this position at the time of posting. jobs.description:
Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. More than 25,000 hospitals across all 50 states rely on Vetcove daily, supporting tens of thousands of veterinarians who care for tens of millions of pets each year.



We are modernizing the 50 billion dollar plus animal health industry by giving veterinary organizations the tools to focus more on patient care. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care.




ABOUT THE ROLE



As a Senior Customer & Content Marketing Manager at Vetcove, you'll own the content and programs that keep veterinary clinics informed, engaged, and connected to Vetcove. From introducing new features and sharing customer success stories to developing educational resources for pet parents, you'll help our customers get more value from our products.



You'll partner closely with Product, Customer Success, Growth, and external partners to turn product updates, clinical expertise, and customer insights into useful, engaging content. You'll manage projects from idea through launch, including writing communications, coordinating video production, building our case study program, and creating thoughtful ways to recognize our clinic community.



This is an ideal role for a strong writer and organized project owner who enjoys both creative work and hands-on execution. You'll have the opportunity to build new programs, shape how Vetcove communicates across its products, and create resources that make life easier for veterinary teams and pet parents.




WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Own Clinic Communications: Plan and write communications about new features, offerings, and product updates, helping clinics understand what's changing and how to take advantage of it. Maintain a consistent content calendar and voice across clinic communications.

 - Build Our Case Study Program: Identify compelling customer stories, interview clinics, capture measurable results, and produce case studies for our website, sales materials, and marketing campaigns.

 - Lead Clinic Engagement Programs: Develop and manage programs that recognize and reward our clinic community, including swag, food deliveries, and other thoughtful gestures. Own the budget, vendor relationships, logistics, and execution.

 - Create Pet Parent Educational Content: Build a library of short, practical videos and supporting resources covering topics such as medication administration and at-home care. Manage scripting, coordination with veterinary subject matter experts, production, and review to ensure content is accurate and easy to understand.

 - Bring Content Into Our Products: Partner with Product to make educational resources available through Vetcove's Home Delivery and practice management platforms, including CRM communications, mobile experiences and other clinic touchpoints.

 - Develop Partner Content: Collaborate with manufacturers and supply chain partners to turn product expertise into useful educational resources for clinics and pet parents.

 - Build Scalable Content Processes: Create content playbooks, templates, and an organized resource library that help teams find, reuse, and maintain approved content. Establish clear workflows for content requests, review, publishing, and updates.

 - Support Vetcove's Brand Presence: Help shape Vetcove's voice across our website, social media, and external announcements, creating content that reflects our values, personality, and clinic community.

 - Measure and Improve Results: Track content engagement, usage, and customer feedback to understand what's working. Use those insights to refine communications, improve educational resources, and prioritize new initiatives.




WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - 5+ years of experience in customer marketing, content marketing, or community marketing, ideally at a B2B software or healthcare company

 - Excellent writing and editing skills, with the ability to make complex topics clear and adapt content for veterinary teams, pet parents, and partners

 - Experience taking content or marketing programs from initial concept through launch, with direct responsibility for execution

 - Strong project management skills, with the ability to manage multiple workstreams, deadlines, vendors, and review processes

 - Experience producing video content or coordinating production, including scripting, working with subject matter experts, and managing external creators

 - Strong relationship building skills and comfort collaborating across Product, Sales, Customer Success, and external partners

 - Sound editorial judgment and attention to detail, including knowing when content requires expert input or review

 - Comfort using engagement data and customer feedback to evaluate and improve your work

 - Ability to work independently, bring structure to new initiatives, and balance creative ideas with practical execution

 - A genuine interest in veterinary care and creating content that helps clinics and pet parents succeed

 - Experience in animal health is a plus but not required




BENEFITS (FULL TIME ROLES)

 - 100% remote within the USA

 - Automatic 401k contribution

 - Employee referral program

 - At home office set up

 - Bi-annual company retreats

 - Open vacation policy

jobs.title: Head of Enterprise Business Development
jobs.description:
Join Vetcove and help modernize the future of veterinary software and the pet parent healthcare experience. Our suite of platforms features a market-leading procurement marketplace, an ultra-modern home delivery ecommerce experience, and a next-generation practice management system. Backed by Y Combinator and top venture investors in Silicon Valley, New York and Miami, Vetcove is a fast-growing, mission-driven company. We are searching for talented and passionate people who want to help shape the future of veterinary care.




ABOUT THE ROLE



Vetcove is seeking a Head of Enterprise Business Development to deepen relationships with the largest veterinary groups in the country and turn those partnerships into significant new growth.



You’ll start from a position of strength: nearly all of these organizations already use and trust Vetcove. Your opportunity is to build on that foundation, get to know their businesses deeply, and expand what we can accomplish together. As Vetcove’s technology grows, you’ll help these organizations evaluate and adopt solutions that shape how their practices operate and drive incremental ROI for their organizations.



This is a senior, hands-on individual contributor role with direct responsibility for winning new business and achieving ambitious revenue goals. You’ll build lasting relationships across executive and operating teams, spend meaningful time with customers in person, and understand their workflows, challenges, and long-term technology ambitions. You’ll turn that understanding into opportunities and lead them through discovery, cross-functional evaluations, RFPs, negotiation, and close.



You’ll also help shape the future of these partnerships across Vetcove’s platforms. Working closely with platform leaders and company leadership, you’ll anticipate customer needs, stay ahead of relationship risks, and bring insights to Product and Engineering that influence what we build next.



The ideal candidate combines the drive and commercial instincts of an exceptional enterprise business developer with the curiosity, judgment, and follow-through to become a trusted long-term partner. You should love both earning a customer’s confidence and turning that confidence into meaningful business.




WHAT YOU’LL DO



 - Build Deep Enterprise Relationships: Develop lasting connections with executive leaders, operational teams, and key decision-makers. Spend time with customers in person, including at their practices, to understand how their organizations work and what matters most to them.

 - Turn Customer Understanding Into Growth: Learn each group’s priorities, workflows, challenges, and future technology needs. Identify opportunities to expand adoption of Vetcove’s platforms and develop new ways to work together.

 - Win Meaningful New Business: Own enterprise expansion opportunities from discovery through close, with an individual revenue target. Build compelling business cases, create momentum, and lead negotiations that result in successful agreements.

 - Lead Complex Evaluations: Guide customers through product evaluations, RFPs, demonstrations, and technical reviews. Understand the buying process, build internal champions, and align executive, operational, financial, and technical stakeholders around a clear path forward.

 - Stay Ahead of Risks and Opportunities: Maintain an informed view of each partnership’s health, including customer sentiment, leadership changes, emerging concerns, and upcoming initiatives. Act early and coordinate the right internal response.

 - Own the Enterprise CRM and Pipeline: Take full ownership of the enterprise CRM and pipeline across all three Vetcove platforms, keeping opportunities, forecasts, relationship risks, and next steps accurate and current. Lead regular pipeline meetings to drive accountability and follow-through, and bring opportunities, risks, and actionable recommendations to the executive team at a regular cadence.

 - Influence What We Build: Translate customer needs into specific, actionable insights for Product, Engineering, and company leadership. Surface important requirements, including integrations, early enough to inform priorities and strengthen our ability to win and deliver.

 - Bring the Right People Together: Partner with platform leaders and teams across Vetcove to deliver thoughtful proposals, well-prepared customer conversations, and credible commitments.

 - Build Partnerships Beyond the Close: Work closely with Implementation and Customer Success to keep customer goals and commitments clear. Stay engaged as a senior relationship partner, supporting long-term success and identifying the next opportunity.

 - Help Scale Our Approach: Turn what works into practical messaging, processes, and playbooks that strengthen how we build relationships, navigate enterprise decisions, and grow partnerships.




YOU SHOULD HAVE



 - 7+ years of experience in enterprise B2B software sales or business development, with a strong record of personally closing significant agreements and exceeding revenue targets.

 - Demonstrated success building deep enterprise relationships and expanding them into substantial new business, including introducing new products or securing broader adoption.

 - Experience leading complex, competitive software evaluations involving formal RFPs, cross-functional buying committees, and multiple levels of approval.

 - The ability to earn credibility with senior executives and frontline teams, paired with genuine curiosity about how their businesses work.

 - Strong discovery, presentation, negotiation, and closing skills, including the ability to build a persuasive business case for meaningful operational change.

 - A proactive approach to managing relationships: staying close to customers, recognizing risks early, and identifying opportunities before they become formal requests.

 - Experience working with Product, Engineering, and other internal teams to address customer requirements and communicate technical capabilities and commitments accurately.

 - A self-directed, entrepreneurial approach. You identify opportunities, create a plan, and keep making progress without waiting for direction.

 - Exceptional preparation, responsiveness, and follow-through. You keep commitments and make sure next steps happen.

 - Experience owning an enterprise CRM and pipeline, leading pipeline reviews, and delivering clear forecasts, opportunities, and risks to executive leadership, with strong discipline around data quality and follow-through.

 - Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to turn complex customer needs into clear recommendations.

 - Willingness and enthusiasm to travel regularly for customer meetings, practice visits, and industry events.

 - An interest in improving veterinary care through technology. Veterinary industry experience is welcome, but not required; we value your ability to learn a new industry deeply.




COMPENSATION



The anticipated base salary range for this role across the United States is $150,000–180,000 per year, plus bonus, equity, and benefits. Anticipated on-target earnings are $250,000–300,000, depending on experience, qualifications, and the final scope of the role.

Actual compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and work location.

 - At-home office setup

 - Biannual company retreats

 - Open vacation policy

 - Monthly team events
